sources.quote: HD 152843 is a single star with a pair of close-orbiting exoplanets, located in the northern constellation of Hercules.

sources.quote: It is positioned at a distance of 356 light years from the Sun based on parallax measurements, and at that range is too faint to be viewed with the naked eye, having an apparent visual magnitude of 8.85.
